annotations.text:
WHY THIS EXISTS (21 NOVEMBER 2026)

The living room NUC was flashed with its cable in the modem. Ready showed the hub's own Wi-Fi as a code to scan, and no such Wi-Fi existed: its Realtek card listed hosting and joining at once and then refused the second interface, every minute, and the hub never tried the card alone. That is fixed in network.sh (the card hosts it on its own interface).

What is left is the screen: the splash drew the code from the unit's settings whenever there was a Wi-Fi card, without asking whether the Wi-Fi had started. So for the first minute or two of every first start, and forever on a card that can't host one, it shows a way in that isn't there.

TODAY

C from design/modem-cable, drawn the moment Ready is reached, whether or not the hub's own Wi-Fi is up. Scanning it joins nothing; typing the name finds nothing.

A: DRAW ONLY WHAT WORKS

A way in is on the screen only once it works. In the modem, Ready is the cable alone (AloneC, already decided) until the hub's own Wi-Fi is really up, then the code joins it as C. On nothing, the first start keeps saying what it is doing until its Wi-Fi is up, and Ready arrives with the code. If the card can't make one, Ready says plug it into the router.

The case: no new layout in the modem, nothing on screen that is untrue for even a minute, and every board but the last is already decided.

The cost: in the modem, the screen changes shape once, a minute or so after Ready, when the code arrives.

RECOMMENDED: A

The screen already follows the network every five seconds, so the code arriving when the Wi-Fi does is what Ready does for a cable today. B adds a waiting tile and two new sentences to explain a minute nobody needs explained.

DECIDED 21 NOVEMBER 2026

A. The recommended direction was asked to be built without stopping to pick.

B: SAY IT'S STARTING

C's layout from the first moment, with the left half honest about its state: an empty tile and "Starting its own Wi-Fi" until the code is there, and "Its own Wi-Fi didn't start" if it never is.

The case: the screen never changes shape.

The cost: Ready is claimed with only one way in that works, and a household reads a waiting tile as the thing to wait for, when the cable is the faster answer.
